product: Rota, a staff-scheduling tool for independent restaurants
audience: Owners of one to three restaurants who build the weekly rota by hand in a spreadsheet
task: A one-page product site whose hero shows a filled weekly rota, with one call to action: start a 14-day trial.
facts: Builds a 7-day rota for up to 40 staff from availability forms in under 2 minutes
Pilot: 12 restaurants in Leeds, March to May 2026; average rota time fell from 3.5 hours to 25 minutes a week
Split shifts and minimum 11-hour rest between shifts are enforced (UK Working Time Regulations)
Price: £29 per site per month; 14-day trial, no card
Staff get their shifts by SMS; swaps need manager approval
Covers forecast: uses the last 8 weeks of covers to suggest staffing per service; one pilot site over-staffed Sunday lunch by 2 servers in week 1
mustInclude: The filled rota grid with names, roles and times
The pilot result with its window and site count
